topic: Evaluating Tenant Quality and Lease Strength
caption:
Tenant quality and lease strength drive reliable income and long-term asset resilience. This lesson helps commercial real estate investors, landlords, building owners, and business owners in Chester County and Montgomery County, Pennsylvania apply a practical review framework. Focus on tenant financials, business durability, lease length and renewal rights, rent escalations and expense responsibilities, guarantors, and security deposits. Understand common expense exposures and what this assessment intentionally excludes. Use this checklist before acquisition, lease signing, or refinance to reduce surprises, improve underwriting, and plan capital needs. Want a local walkthrough or a tailored checklist? Visit dmsellscre.com/investors to get started.
